question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**travelled**" means to go from one place to another, especially over a significant distance. (यात्रा की)
 
• In this context, **"travelled"** is the most appropriate as it describes the movement of Chinese pottery along the same routes used for silk.
 
• The other options: "**migrated**," "**stayed**," and "**walked**" do not fit the context as effectively. "Migrate" often implies a permanent move, while "stayed" and "walked" are not suitable given the context of trade routes.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *But Chinese pottery also travelled__ the same route, as did textiles and spices from India and Southeast Asia.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Migrated (प्रवासन करना)**: means to move from one place to another, often permanently.
 
• **Stayed (ठहरा रहा)**: means to remain in one place.
 
• **Walked (चला)**: means to move by putting one foot in front of the other.
